title: SAE-SSV: Supervised Steering in Sparse Representation Spaces for Reliable Control of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of representation steering methods to intentionally shift the political polarity of a language model's generated outputs from left-leaning to right-leaning stances, using prompts from the TwinViews-13k dataset and measuring the steering success rate with an automated LLM evaluator (GPT-4o-mini).
